fact: Convalt Energy, a US company, whose CEO Hari Achuthan says the Kobong hydropower and AI data centre project involves about US$6.2 billion (M100 billion) of capital investment in Lesotho, launched on 31 July 2026 after a binding agreement signed 4 June 2026.

Convalt Energy, a US company, signed a binding agreement with Lesotho's Ministry of Energy on 4 June 2026 for Project Kobong, a hydropower and AI data centre development valued at M98 billion (about US$6.2 billion) and called the largest foreign investment commitment in Lesotho's history; construction is targeted for 2029 subject to feasibility.

Convalt Energy, a US company, signed a binding Memorandum of Agreement with Lesotho's Ministry of Energy on 4 June 2026 for Project Kobong, a hydropower and AI data centre project valued at about US$6.2 billion (98 billion maloti), expected to be the largest foreign direct investment in Lesotho's history.
